F02-SYSTEM / 1.0.0-candidate.2
Shared anatomy, tokens, charts, tables, evidence and recovery.
Draft for independent review
Native editable construction. Production behavior remains unverified.

THE USER JOURNEY
Question & period → comparison → limitations → exact evidence → return → owner-confirmed action

Own the shared behavior
Read a dense comparison in light or dark. Distinguish direction from workflow status, unknown from zero, stale from partial, and selection from focus. Open the exact row and return without losing context.
Preserve domain meaning
F01 owns navigation and shell composition. D07 owns Company statement modes; D08 owns the Options workflow; D23/current service owns save confirmation. Verdicts, count partitions and lifecycle transitions retain their domain owners.

Current qualification
Direct Paper construction is qualified. F01 joint shell release, admitted independent review, real keyboard/touch/400% browser behavior and consumer integration remain separate gates. Every new numerical example is an illustrative fixture. No product code, merge or deployment is implied.

How participation is calculated
Expanded −
Numerator: covered securities whose close is above their 50-day moving average. Denominator: covered securities with both valid observations. Coverage is shown separately from the statistic.

Keyboard, touch and route continuity
Modal: named dialog, initial focus, focus trap, Escape and close return. Dock: no trap. Preserve the existing URL-addressable tab, sort/filter state and scroll on return. Important phone actions are 44px. A 400% zoom view requires actual browser verification; Paper drawings specify expected reflow only.

Save belongs to D23 / the existing service
Idle → pending → saved only after owner confirmation/readback. Pending disables duplicate send. Failure retains the draft for recovery. An expired session after dispatch produces uncertain outcome and reconciliation, not “nothing was sent.” Theme, locale, region and navigation changes do not save.

Source and exact-value access
Counts 657, 663, —, 679, 673, 687, 697, 709 / 1063. Seven of eight sessions; 23 Oct is missing. Independent universe cohort; no interpolation. Synthetic universe: 709/1063 × 100 = 66.70%; prior 697/1063 = 65.57%. Raw-count change +1.13 pp; relative +1.72%. Independent of sector examples; round only after calculation. In implementation every point has keyboard/touch access to the same exact-value receipt; the table provides an equivalent path. A timestamped source clock and coverage label accompany the figure. The incumbent lib/illus.py cleaner drops nulls: a gap-rendering change needs the later domain implementation and proof.

TABLE
Caption, scoped column headers and stable row identity.
Right-align numeric values; preserve native precision in export. Raw values sort, missing values last. Truncation never hides the only route to full identity. Keep controls in fixed lanes.
CHART
Declare unit, scale, period and missing-data behavior.
No decorative smoothing. Series have labels and distinguishable marks. Use 12px minimum axis labels in dense analytics. Long Company histories scroll inside a named frame, with all 17 × 5 raw observations available.

Virtualized and narrow data
Retain the real DataInspector 50,000-row cap, time keys and keyboard behavior. Virtualization is a performance implementation detail, not permission to omit rows from accessible navigation or export. Keep horizontal movement local to the table/chart; full-row evidence gives a readable narrow path.

steps.html:
F02-P12 / BUILD CONTRACT
Integrate through the existing owners.
This kit specifies shared anatomy and behavior. It preserves source contracts, domain semantics and existing capabilities.

Macro
theme.css · actual current chart/table builders
Source observation + coverage; no null-to-zero or interpolation.

Company / D07
CompanyAnalysisWorkspace · getFund / getBars / intel / quote
Entity/listing identity, request-race guards, annual/quarterly and statement currency.

Options / D08
meta.observed_statistics · options.observed_statistics_snapshot/v1
Print window ≠ expiry buckets. Side evidence ≠ workflow health. Transport ≠ freshness.

Public editorial
seo_article / seo_base
English article body, bilingual chrome, canonical anchors and existing routes.

Save / D23
Existing mutation service and owner-confirmed readback
Pending deduplication, recoverable failure and reconciliation for uncertain outcome.

Domain patterns
Retained verdict / decision / count / lifecycle boards
Shared anatomy must not redefine verdict authority, count partitions or transitions.

Responsive acceptance matrix
320/390: compact header, one vertical hierarchy, 44px actions and modal evidence. 768/1024: avoid shrinking dense data below its meaningful minimum; use local scroll. 1280/1440/1600: dock only with ≥640px primary region. Baseline rail224/header64/mainpad24 remains provisional until F01 joint release.

Required real-path acceptance
Normal, unknown, zero, loading, empty, partial + stale, error, denied/expired access and pending/failed/uncertain save. Light/dark; EN/ZH chrome; keyboard, touch, focus return, URL/history, 400% reflow. Test representative actual consumers before adoption. Static design and Paper readback do not establish runtime behavior.

Targets and migration
Future p75 targets: LCP ≤2.5s, INP ≤200ms, CLS ≤0.1; no current measurements asserted. Migrate one consumer slice behind its existing owner, preserve routes/auth/data shape, compare before/after, then expand. Roll back by restoring the prior component/template mapping, not by deleting retained evidence.

Review and continuity
Native Paper construction is a candidate for independent product and visual critique. Existing first-pass reports and repaired static artifact sets remain immutable. PRC-007 consumer-integration qualification remains open. Sector, Prophet and Refraction holds/conditions retain their original authority; this file creates no RIG approval.
